description: Compare multiple solar cells side by side — power-conversion efficiency (PCE), raw power, and a coverage/ranking table. PCE is the fair comparison metric since it normalizes for cell area.

panels.title: Power Conversion Efficiency (PCE) — per cell
panels.description: PCE(%) = 1000 × P[mW] / (irradiance[W/m²] × area[cm²]) for each selected cell. MPP-tracking mode only, irradiance > $min_irr W/m². Buckets aligned to the panel interval.

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    sc.name      AS cell_name,
    sc.area_cm2  AS area_cm2,
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, mfc.measured_at) AS t,
    AVG(mfc.power_mw) AS power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
    AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
  GROUP BY sc.name, sc.area_cm2, 3
),
irr AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS t,
    AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND irradiance > $min_irr
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  p.t         AS time,
  p.cell_name AS metric,
  1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0) AS pce
FROM p
JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Power — per cell
panels.description: Raw MPP power for each selected cell (MPP-tracking mode). Not area-normalized — use PCE for fair comparison.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, mfc.measured_at) AS time,
  sc.name AS metric,
  AVG(mfc.power_mw) AS power
FROM solar_cell sc
CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) mfc
WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
  AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
GROUP BY 1, sc.name
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average PCE Ranking
panels.description: Mean PCE per selected cell over the range (MPP-tracking mode, irradiance > $min_irr W/m²).

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT sc.name AS cell_name, sc.area_cm2,
    time_bucket('5 minutes', mfc.measured_at) AS t,
    AVG(mfc.power_mw) AS power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
    AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
  GROUP BY sc.name, sc.area_cm2, 3
),
irr AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) AS t, AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND irradiance > $min_irr
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.cell_name AS "Cell",
  AVG(1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) AS "Avg PCE"
FROM p JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
GROUP BY p.cell_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Comparison & Coverage
panels.description: Per-cell summary: average/peak PCE, average power, and data coverage (from mpp_data_coverage). Ranked by average PCE.

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT sc.name AS cell_name, sc.area_cm2,
    time_bucket('5 minutes', mfc.measured_at) AS t,
    AVG(mfc.power_mw) AS power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
    AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
  GROUP BY sc.name, sc.area_cm2, 3
),
irr AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) AS t, AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND irradiance > $min_irr
  GROUP BY 1
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT p.cell_name,
    AVG(p.power_mw) AS avg_power,
    AVG(1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) AS avg_pce,
    MAX(1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) AS peak_pce
  FROM p JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
  GROUP BY p.cell_name
)
SELECT
  cov.cell_name         AS "Cell",
  m.avg_pce             AS "Avg PCE (%)",
  m.peak_pce            AS "Peak PCE (%)",
  m.avg_power           AS "Avg Power (mW)",
  cov.total_days        AS "Days w/ Data",
  cov.first_measurement AS "First Data",
  cov.last_measurement  AS "Last Data"
FROM mpp_data_coverage cov
LEFT JOIN metrics m ON m.cell_name = cov.cell_name
WHERE cov.cell_name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
ORDER BY m.avg_pce DESC NULLS LAST
